data.name: The Green Earth
data.detailed_description:
You Have Reached The Green Earth

The Green Earth is a traditional roguelike taking place in a vast jungle. Ages ago an Ancient Culture used unimaginable technology to warp the inhabitants of a rainforest in truly bizarre ways. This civilization disappeared long before your people emerged, but ruins of their great city still exist hidden deep in the wilderness. Now it is your turn to enter The Green Earth, seeking the only means to save your mother from a deadly illness. The journey won't be easy and there's no guarantee you'll return alive. You'll have to make sacrifices if you wish to get back home...

True Open World

The Green Earth takes the classic top-down grid, turn-based gameplay of classic roguelikes and sets it in a fully open world. Go anywhere with no distinct floors or borders breaking up the map. Different environments have unique ways to interact with them: grass can be set on fire, water conducts electricity and many hazards are just as deadly to the creatures of the jungle as they are to you. Explore 12+ biomes from steaming rainforests to damp swamps to mushroom groves and volcanos. And at the heart of the jungle, discover the ruins of an ancient temple where your fate will be decided.

Deep Customization

Mix and match Background and Tribes for 150+ starting combinations then further customize your character with dozens of Passive Skills, Active Skills and Items designed to allow creating powerful synergies. Your chosen Tribe can radically alter how the game is played such as causing unique enemies to spawn, changing how skills or equipment work or even allowing new ways to use items. Eventually you can discover Symbiosis which unlock even more tools to survive the brutality of The Green Earth.

A Deadly Ecosystem

The jungle of The Green Earth hosts a complex biosphere of 36+ monsters with unique abilities and behaviors. Creatures range from jaguars and monkeys to giant, cordyceps-infected ants to huge multitle bosses like the fire drake and the terrifying guardian of the ancient city. If you can survive these threats though they'll drop unique resources which you can use in crafting recipes to further empower your character. Be carefull though, animals aren't the only threat. You aren't alone...

The Green Earth is in active development and more updates will be released soon.

data.short_description: Survive the madness of an ancient jungle in this open-world, traditional roguelike. Do whatever it takes to escape alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1600 x 900 Monitor
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The Green Earth contains frequent violence, pixel art blood and mild gore.
